method: python training/confirm_like_blend.py --data-dir ml-32m Same 1-in-5 MovieLens 32M sample, time split, and 3,000 validation / 3,000 test viewers as training/confirm_like.py. Source movie X = each viewer's most recent liked movie ("I just watched X"). Target = the movies they went on to love (held-out ratings of 4+).
